fields.nasa_gistemp_anomaly_c_1951_1980: NASA annual global land-ocean anomaly; native 1951-1980 baseline
fields.noaa_globaltemp_anomaly_c_1971_2000: NOAA annual global land-ocean anomaly; native 1971-2000 baseline
fields.co2_ppm: NOAA annual global surface marine boundary layer dry-air CO2 mole fraction
fields.forcing_total_long_lived_ghg_w_m2: NOAA AGGI effective radiative forcing relative to preindustrial
fields.ch4_ppb: NOAA annual global methane dry-air mole fraction
fields.n2o_ppb: NOAA annual global nitrous oxide dry-air mole fraction

fields.anthropogenic_co2_sources_gtco2: Global Carbon Budget fossil/industry plus net land-use-change source estimate
fields.cumulative_anthropogenic_co2_sources_sin: arithmetic cumulative sum of annual source estimates

series.warning: This cumulative source series is a transparent dashboard approximation. Do not use it to recalculate IPCC TCRE or carbon budgets without applying the exact IPCC net-emissions definitions and uncertainty treatment.

series.grain: one row per year and PRIMAP priority scenario
series.boundary: National totals excluding LULUCF; international aviation and shipping excluded; 2024 includes extrapolation where source inventories are unavailable
series.accounting_metric: AR6 GWP100 for Kyoto-gas and F-gas aggregate fields
series.warning: CO2e is an emissions-accounting metric, not an atmospheric concentration or radiative-forcing measurement.
Do not linearly interpolate annual temperatures from period means without a model-derived annual scenario series.

null_policy: Null means unavailable or outside source coverage; never coerce to zero.
precision_policy: Display no more precision than the source assessment supports.
